pictures.author: MM
pictures.observations: Entire960x683 capital/entablature view inspected. Three columns in a straight row, leafy Corinthian capitals with curling corner volutes, deeply fluted necks, stepped architrave bands, large scrolling vegetal frieze, egg/dentil rhythm and three projecting surviving upper cornice masses with deep missing sections and rough rear core. Fine carving is simplified as original broad forms.

pictures.author: Tournasol7
pictures.observations: Entire500x687 full-height picture inspected. Exactly three slender fluted standing shafts on layered round/square bases and a low connected stone footing; warm weathered shaft areas and irregular white repair sections, dark repair hoops on the outer shafts, three capitals and broken straight entablature. Low scattered ruins/ground remain open. This useful full-height view resolved bases hidden by earlier cropped/end-on pictures; no tall whole-site podium is inferred.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific surviving Venus Genetrix remains: three mapped re-erected fluted Corinthian columns in a straight southwest-side row, layered bases, two leafy capital rows and volutes, concave abaci, straight three-fascia architrave, original simplified scrolling frieze, bead/dentil rhythms and the conspicuously broken three-mass cornice. Approximate warm weathering/white repairs and metal shaft hoops; mapped low cella/podium fragments with an open interior. No intact temple roof, pediment or full colonnade is restored; surrounding forum monuments stay independent.
